title: At Minao Asian Food, every dish has a soul.
description:
Between Chinese and Thai cuisine,

our family recipes are prepared with passion and 100% halal.

Stir-fried noodles, fragrant rice, gyoza, bao or pad thai

a true culinary journey awaits you.

For a romantic dinner or an evening with friends,

let yourself be tempted, we’ll take care of the rest. 🍜❤️
